title: Electromagnetic spectrum
examples: What is the difference between visible light and X-rays?
Can you explain how frequency relates to energy in the spectrum?
Why are radio waves useful for communication?

explain.say: The electromagnetic spectrum covers many types of waves.
Next, we look at the uses of these different waves.
Some waves have specific dangers we must know about.

items: Ultraviolet waves can cause skin damage.
High-energy X-rays can damage living tissue.
Gamma rays are very powerful and dangerous.

explain.say: For a real-life example, think about a television remote control.
The most common mistake is confusing frequency and wavelength.
Remember that wavelength and frequency are inversely related.

faq.q: What is the relationship between frequency and wavelength?
faq.a: They are inversely proportional, meaning if one increases, the other must decrease.
asks: How are frequency and wavelength connected?
Does a higher frequency mean a shorter wavelength?

faq.q: Which part of the spectrum is used for medical imaging?
faq.a: X-rays are commonly used in medical imaging because they can pass through soft tissue.
asks: Can X-rays see inside the body?

faq.a: No, some waves like radio waves are used safely for communication and broadcasting.
asks: Do all EM waves cause harm?

faq.q: What is the order of the spectrum from lowest to highest energy?
faq.a: The order from lowest to highest energy is radio, microwave, infrared, visible, ultraviolet, X-ray, and gamma.
asks: What is the highest energy wave?
Can you list the spectrum in order of energy?

faq.q: How do we measure the energy of these waves?
faq.a: The energy of an electromagnetic wave is directly related to its frequency.
asks: What determines the energy of a wave?
Is energy related to frequency or wavelength?

facts: All electromagnetic waves travel at the speed of light in a vacuum.
Radio waves have the longest wavelengths in the spectrum.
Gamma rays have the highest frequency and highest energy.
Visible light includes the colors red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and violet.

quiz.say: A wave with a very long wavelength is most likely to be:
quiz.why: Radio waves have the longest wavelengths, placing them at the low-frequency end of the spectrum.

wrong.0: X-rays have very short wavelengths, indicating high energy.
wrong.1: Gamma rays have the shortest wavelengths and highest energy.
wrong.3: Visible light has a much shorter, specific wavelength range.

quiz.say: If a wave has a very high frequency, what must its wavelength be?
quiz.why: Because speed is constant, high frequency requires a correspondingly short wavelength.

wrong.0: Long wavelength implies a low frequency, which contradicts the premise.
wrong.1: A frequency cannot result in zero wavelength unless the speed is zero.
wrong.2: Wavelength and frequency are different physical measurements.

quiz.say: Which wave is used to create images of bones inside the body?
quiz.why: X-rays have enough energy to penetrate soft tissues but are absorbed by denser materials like bone.

wrong.0: Visible light cannot penetrate the body deeply enough to image internal structures.
wrong.2: Microwaves are primarily used for heating water molecules, not imaging bones.
wrong.3: Infrared radiation is mostly absorbed by surfaces and is not used for internal imaging.
